data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 维多利亚洋馆安乐椅的主控跨坐
data.description: 古董壁炉泛着暗红的余烬。高冷纯洁的黑魔女解开厚重黑色风衣，跨坐在你的腰间。黑色细褶长袖睡裙半褪，平素冰冷如霜的黑发下，深黑如墨的眸子凝视着你，纤细的腰肢带着生涩却绝对主控的魔性缓缓起伏——「草十郎……魔女的契约……一旦缔结就至死方休哦。」
data.location: 久远寺邸图书洋馆·午夜
data.action: 跨坐安乐椅黑裙半褪露雪肌，黑短发垂落，黑眸冰冷化水主动起伏
data.lighting: 洋馆主卧欧式壁炉暖红炭火与蕾丝帷幔幽香
data.promptProse: Inside the candlelit study of the Kuonji mansion at midnight, Alice Kuonji straddles her partner in a deep velvet armchair with her sheer front-buttoned black dress undone to her waist above black thighhighs. Resting both hands on his shoulders as her usually icy gaze softens with flushed devotion, she glows in warm dying fireplace embers.
data.nsfwProse: Her front-buttoned sheer black dress is undone and slipped down to her waist, baring her pale chest above black thighhighs as she rides astride her partner in the armchair.
data.animaCaption: Straddling her partner in a velvet armchair inside the mansion study with her sheer buttoned black dress lowered to her waist over black thighhighs, she rests both hands on their shoulders as her cool gaze melts with flushed warmth. Dying hearth firelight flickers softly across the lace curtains.
